vindūnāṃ viduṣāṃ
matibhiḥ kramyante avagamyanta iti vindumatikramairgūḍhāśayaślokaiḥ

phullaiḥ puṣpairlatābhirguñjābhirvā dehasya gopanaṃ pidhānaṃ yeṣu
tathāvidhairnakhavraṇairnakṣakṣataiḥ

yugmabhūtahastyaśvānāṃ dāntānāṃ damanena
śikṣitānāmuṣṭrādīnāṃ ca gamāgamaiścṃkramaṇaparivartanaiḥ
nanu yā strī bhartrā'nanujñātā upavāsavrataṃ caret
pratyakṣaṃ vā parokṣaṃ vā sadā bhartṛhitaṃ caret
sarvasmin śāstrārthe astyavaśyaṃ phalamiti buddhiḥ sarvāstikyam
yadā yadā varārthāya darśanāya prārthaye tadā darśanaṃ dehītyanvayaḥ
pakṣā nemikaṭakā māsā madhyakaṭakā ṛtavo nābhikaṭakā yasya

dehasya iti ṣaṣṭhyekavacanāntaṃ
padametat 45 tamaślokagataraṇakhaṇḍitadehe iti saptamyekavacananirdeśakamiti
bhāti

patyustatprāṇanādiliṅgaiḥ pratyakṣaprāyaṃ cetanaṃ tanau liṅgadehe
antardhi tirobhāvamāyayau
srotasaḥ pravāhasya kṣaye śoṣe kṣāreṇoṣeṇa vidhūsarā
